points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Prior structural examiner pass does not prove physics. M2 laminar metadata says converged despite Cd falling 20.6% in last62 rows; transient restart loses preceding state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior eight-case/report examiner validator passed; current manager gates check structure and index, not physical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Three inviscid plateaus are justified by bounded late residuals and stable Cl/Cd; M2 laminar Cd falls 20.6% in final 62 rows while status claims converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 selected Cd≈1.997 is plausible and Re200 FFT St≈0.14 is stable by time window; M2 laminar Cd declines 20.6% immediately before reported convergence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF p10 Re20 contours are compressed into strips and late force detail is hidden by startup; p10 Re200 late force oscillations unreadable while p11 wake zoom is visible.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:501–509 discloses plateau acceptance, supported for inviscid cases. It labels M2 laminar converged despite changing drag and shows compressed cylinder plots.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Accepted PDF and standalone figure manifests/hashes are recorded; case metadata git_revision=null and selected M2 result predates final source, so exact producing revision unbound.
